### Matchmaking and setup, about 0–40 seconds

Dacz8976 matches with BigGutSnorlax and is assigned first turn (`021-owner-going-first.jpg`). The owner's opening five are visibly **Igglybuff, Darkrai, Copycat, Professor's Research, and Eevee**; Igglybuff is the only Basic set Active. The opponent sets lone **Oricorio** Active. No Bench Pokémon or Energy are in play, and the score is 0–0 (`041-initial-board.jpg`). Oricorio's visible Safeguard prevents attack damage from Pokémon ex.

### Dacz8976 turn 1, about 41–87 seconds

The visible turn draw is a second **Eevee** (`044-owner-draw-eevee.jpg`). The owner Benches the opening Darkrai, plays **Professor's Research**, and visibly draws **Poke Ball** and **Small Balloon** (`049-owner-research-play.jpg`, `053-research-results-pokeball-balloon.jpg`). The owner then plays Poke Ball; it returns a second **Darkrai**, which is Benched (`055-owner-pokeball-play.jpg`, `058-pokeball-darkrai-result.jpg`, `060-second-darkrai-benched.jpg`). One Eevee is also Benched (`068-eevee-benched.jpg`). Going first supplies no Energy attachment on this turn.

Igglybuff uses zero-cost **Sleepy Lullaby**, dealing 10 and making Oricorio Asleep (`070-sleepy-lullaby.jpg`). The two Benched Darkrai then resolve **Bad Dreams** in order for 20 each: Oricorio moves 70→60 from the attack, then 60→40→20 (`075-first-bad-dreams.jpg`, `078-second-bad-dreams.jpg`). Pokémon Checkup follows because the target remains in play. The coin is visibly **Heads**, and the game reports that Oricorio recovered from Sleep (`084-sleep-check-heads.jpg`, `086-oricorio-recovers.jpg`). End state: owner Active Igglybuff30; Bench Darkrai100, Eevee50, Darkrai100; opponent lone Active Oricorio20 and awake; score 0–0.

### Dacz8976 turn 3, about 116–173 seconds

The visible turn draw is **Poke Ball** (`117-owner-draw-pokeball.jpg`). That same card is then played and returns **Swablu** (`119-owner-pokeball-play.jpg`, `121-pokeball-swablu-result.jpg`). This is a draw followed by a play, not two Poke Ball plays.

The owner attaches **Small Balloon** to the left Darkrai (`127-small-balloon-attached-darkrai.jpg`) and plays **Copycat** (`128-copycat-play.jpg`). Copycat shuffles the held Swablu and Eevee back into the deck and produces four visible replacement cards: **Sabrina, Swablu, Training Area, and Field Blower** (`141-copycat-result-sabrina.jpg` through `144-copycat-result-field-blower.jpg`). The later Swablu therefore does not imply that Poke Ball was left unplayed. The first generated Psychic Energy is attached to the Benched Eevee (`153-first-psychic-to-eevee.jpg`).

Igglybuff uses Sleepy Lullaby again: Oricorio20→10 and becomes Asleep (`160-second-sleepy-lullaby.jpg`). The first Bad Dreams placement Knocks Out the 10-HP Oricorio; the second Darkrai's ability also announces, but there is no second live-target HP transition. No Sleep check occurs because Oricorio leaves play (`166-bad-dreams-knockout.jpg`). Dacz8976 receives one point (`171-owner-first-point.jpg`).

### BigGutSnorlax turn 6, about 242–280 seconds

The turn draw is hidden. BigGutSnorlax Benches **Team Rocket's Voltorb**, attaches the turn's Lightning to the still-Benched Electrike, and plays **Training Area** (`246-first-voltorb-benched.jpg`, `247-lightning-to-benched-electrike.jpg`, `255-opponent-training-area-play.jpg`). The Active Mega Manectric uses Lightning Accelerator. With one opponent point and Training Area, the calculation is `80 + 30 + 10 = 120`; the displayed 120 Knocks Out Eevee50 (`273-lightning-accelerator-120.jpg`). BigGutSnorlax receives a second point (`278-opponent-second-point.jpg`). The owner promotes Swablu (`281-swablu-promoted.jpg`).

### Dacz8976 turn 7, about 281–316 seconds

The visible draw is **Espeon** (`287-owner-draw-espeon.jpg`). Active Swablu evolves into **Mega Altaria ex**, preserving its first Psychic Energy (`290-mega-altaria-evolution.jpg`). The owner Benches the Eevee drawn by Research, filling the Bench with two Darkrai and Eevee (`298-eevee-benched.jpg`), then attaches a second Psychic to Mega Altaria (`301-second-psychic-to-mega-altaria.jpg`). A warning shows that Sabrina remains usable, but the owner does not play it this turn (`304-sabrina-unused-warning.jpg`).

Mega Harmony displays and deals **140**: `40 + 30×3 owner Bench + 10 Training Area = 140`. The opponent's first Mega Manectric moves 170→30 (`313-mega-harmony-displays-140.jpg`, `315-first-mega-harmony-hit.jpg`). Score remains 1–2.

### BigGutSnorlax turn 8, about 317–353 seconds

The draw is hidden. The opponent evolves the first Team Rocket's Voltorb into **Team Rocket's Electrode** and attaches one Lightning to it (`318-electrode-evolution.jpg`). A **Protective Poncho** is attached to the damaged Active Mega Manectric (`323-protective-poncho-play.jpg`). The opponent then Benches a second Team Rocket's Voltorb and evolves the remaining Electrike into a fresh **Mega Manectric ex**, carrying forward the Lightning attached on turn 6 (`332-second-voltorb-benched.jpg`, `335-second-mega-manectric-evolution.jpg`).

The damaged Mega Manectric has zero retreat cost, so it retreats without discarding Energy; Electrode is promoted (`342-electrode-promoted.jpg`). Once the damaged Mega is on the Bench, Protective Poncho visibly activates its prevention against opposing attack and Ability damage (`343-protective-poncho-activates.jpg`). Electrode uses **Random Spark** for 30 on the owner's left Darkrai, moving it 100→70; Training Area does not add damage because the attack targets the Bench (`348-random-spark-thirty.jpg`, `350-darkrai-seventy.jpg`). Score stays 1–2.

### Dacz8976 turn 9, about 354–391 seconds

The visible draw is a second **Espeon**; the next frame fans two copies in hand, and one evolves the Benched Eevee (`356-owner-draw-second-espeon.jpg`, `359-eevee-evolves-espeon.jpg`). The owner plays **Sabrina**. The opponent chooses the fresh 180-HP Mega Manectric as the new Active and returns Electrode to the Bench (`362-owner-sabrina-play.jpg`).

The exact public decision root is retained at `374-post-sabrina-decision-root.jpg`: opponent Active fresh Mega Manectric180 with one Lightning; Bench damaged Mega Manectric30 with two Lightning and Protective Poncho, Electrode70 with one Lightning, and Voltorb60; Training Area in play; owner Active Mega Altaria190 with two Psychic; Bench damaged Darkrai70 with Small Balloon, Espeon90, and Darkrai100; score 1–2; a Psychic Energy is available; owner hand is Training Area, Field Blower, and the second Espeon.

The recorded line attaches that Psychic Energy to the damaged left Darkrai (`383-psychic-attachment-to-damaged-darkrai.jpg`). The owner does not retreat. Mega Altaria's displayed retreat cost is one Energy (`386-mega-altaria-retreat-cost.jpg`). Mega Harmony again deals 140, moving the fresh Mega Manectric180→40 (`390-second-mega-harmony-140.jpg`). The owner's later statement that the Balloon plus Energy was an escape plan against a possible Cyrus is testimony about intent; the source itself proves the attachment and board state.

### BigGutSnorlax turn 10 and result, about 392–412.87 seconds

The draw is hidden. BigGutSnorlax first plays **Cyrus**, whose readable text switches one damaged opposing Benched Pokémon into the Active Spot (`397-5-opponent-cyrus-play.jpg`). The Sabrina card visible in the owner's discard is not the source of this switch. The damaged 70-HP Darkrai is the only eligible damaged owner Bench Pokémon, so Cyrus pulls it Active with Small Balloon (`401-cyrus-switches-darkrai-active.jpg`). The opponent then attaches a second Lightning to the 40-HP Active Mega Manectric; the attachment and settled two-Energy state are visible (`403-second-lightning-to-active-mega.jpg`, `404-pre-attack-energy-state.jpg`). The Psychic previously attached to Darkrai is also visible after the switch in the latter frame; it was attached during the owner's turn, not generated by the opponent's attack.

The attack's readable text is 80 plus 30 for each point the user has obtained (`405-lightning-accelerator-text.jpg`). With two opponent points and Training Area, Lightning Accelerator deals **150**: `80 + 30×2 + 10 = 150`. It Knocks Out Darkrai70 before the owner receives another action window, so Small Balloon cannot enable the planned retreat (`407-lightning-accelerator-150.jpg`). BigGutSnorlax receives the third point (`413-opponent-third-point.jpg`). The recording ends on this terminal 1–3 animation without a separate Defeat screen and contains no continuation.
